description: This Java file contains a JUnit test class 'JwtHelperTest' that verifies the behavior of the 'JwtHelper' class, specifically testing token expiration detection using JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). It includes a single test method 'testIsExpired' that generates an expired token and checks if the helper correctly identifies expiration.

classes.name: JwtHelperTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of 'JwtHelper', focusing on token expiration logic.

methods.name: testIsExpired
